{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Representative Commission''' was a branch of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. Made up of junior [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] who represented the minority races on their homeworlds, the Commission allowed for a wide range of viewpoints to be addressed, not just the condensed versions some Senators maintained in order to remain efficient. [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] was appointed to this organization, eventually becoming the [[Junior Representative/Legends|Senior Representative]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
